summary: Double classifier (__cdecl): takes a 64-bit double split into two 32-bit halves (low a1, high a2) and returns an integer class code. Returns 1 for +infinity, 2 for -infinity, 3 when the high-word exponent bits mask to 0x7FF8 (NaN-like), 4 when the exponent is all-ones with a nonzero mantissa/low word, and 0 otherwise (zero/subnormal path).

operations.description: Guard: if a2 == 2146435072 (0x7FF00000) and a1 == 0, return 1 (positive infinity).
Guard: else if a2 == -1048576 and a1 == 0, return 2 (negative infinity).
Guard: if (HIWORD(a2) & 0x7FF8) == 0x7FF0 and ((a2 & 0x7FFFF) != 0 or a1 != 0), return 4 (exponent all-ones with nonzero mantissa).
Fall-through return 0 for values matching none of the special cases.
Called by sub_5895A2 (0x005895A2) and FloatClassify (0x0058A8A3) as the double special-value classification helper.

unresolved: The 64-bit double is passed as two 32-bit integers (lo=a1, hi=a2); classification inspects the high half only.
Return codes 1..4 map to +inf/-inf/NaN/nonzero-exponent by branch inspection; no external contract confirms the exact meaning of code 4 vs code 3.
